in_sanskrit.name: Avantisha
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Desirable, Worthy
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Avantisha एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Avantisha is a Sanskrit name derived from the words 'avanti' meaning 'desirable' and 'isha' meaning 'goddess' or 'ruler'. This name signifies a woman who is worthy of admiration and respect, a goddess in her own right.
